# Context readiness: <repo name>

Ratings by `/context-assess`; the score is calculated by `context-tools.cjs readiness`, which never
lets a rating exceed what the evidence supports (draft pages count at most 2, unreviewed at most 3).

| Dimension | Rating (0-5) | Evidence | Main gaps | Independent check |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| code-understanding | | | | no |
| architecture | | | | no |
| domain | | | | no |
| data | | | | no |
| api | | | | no |
| dependencies | | | | no |
| security | | | | no |
| testing | | | | no |
| operations | | | | no |
| decisions | | | | no |

Provenance and freshness are measured by the tool, not rated.
